en.headline: Customs and Immigration run cross-department drill at new Huanggang Port
en.dek: About 50 officers from Customs, Immigration, police, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency practised vehicle and passenger clearance procedures, including system faults and reverse exits, ahead of the port’s opening.
body: Hong Kong Customs, the Immigration Department and three other government departments conducted a joint drill at the new Huanggang Port on Tuesday to test clearance procedures before the facility opens.

About 50 officers from Customs, Immigration, the police, the Department of Health and the Government Property Agency took part in the exercise at the passenger halls and the five-in-one vehicle lanes on the Hong Kong side. The drill simulated normal vehicle clearance as well as special situations such as inspection-system faults and vehicles that need to reverse out of the joint one-stop lanes.

The Immigration Department said the focus included handling various emergencies and abnormal situations under the new cooperative inspection and one-stop release e-channel system. Customs noted that the exercise helped departments familiarise themselves with the new five-in-one vehicle inspection process and strengthened communication for unexpected events.

On the Shenzhen side, the municipal port office also held an elevator pressure test and passenger flow drill at the new joint inspection building the same afternoon, involving more than 3,000 simulated travellers.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸跨部門通關演練 模擬系統故障及倒車離場
zh.dek: 海關、入境處、警務處、衞生署及政府產業署約50人周二在港方口岸區演練人車通關程序，包括查驗系統故障及車輛倒車離開聯合一站式車道等突發情况。
body: 為迎接新皇崗口岸啟用，香港海關、入境事務處、警務處、衞生署及政府產業署約50名人員周二在港方口岸區出入境大堂及「五合一」車道進行跨部門聯合通關演練。
入境處表示，演練重點包括模擬全新「合作查驗、一次放行」e-道處理各類突發事故及異常情况的通關流程，測試應急預案並加強跨部門協同指揮及應變能力。海關則指，除正常車輛通關流程外，亦模擬查驗系統故障、車輛需折返倒車離開「聯合一站式」車道等特别情况。
新皇崗口岸採用「五合一車檢」新程序，今次演練有助各部門更熟習新清關流程，並加強突發情况下的溝通協作，確保口岸運作暢順、有序及安全。
同日下午，深圳市口岸辦亦在皇崗口岸新聯檢大樓進行電梯運行壓力測試及旅客通關動線演練，超過3,000名模擬旅客參與。
